newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Energy firms on Mobil settlement, result.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Energy firms on Mobil settlement, result.

text.p: Fletcher Energy shares jumped 12 cents to $NZ5.60 on Wednesday after the company announced a $308 million profit for the year to June 30.

But brokers said the rise was helped by the strong performance of the Dow Jones Industrials overnight and by an announcmeent at the close on Tuesday that Fletcher Energy had settled its remaining royalty payments with Mobil Oil.

"With Fletcher Energy you have to remember they made an announcement about settling their Mobil royalties yesterday which also adds value and that was pre their result," Vicki St John at brokers First NZ Capital said.
She said otherwise it was difficult to separate the effects of the result from the impact a rising market driven Wall St's rise.

"In net, three out of the four (Fletcher stocks) have gone quite strongly. although all the results if you take the glaringly abnormals out -- and these results do take some time to digest -- they all look pretty much in line certainly from where we stand," St John said.
The market had expected Fletcher Energy to announce a net profit of $260 million. The $308 million profit to June included a $39 million net gain from one-off factors.
Richard Dwyer at brokers Hamilton Hindin Greene said the Mobil announcement had been "a sweetener" that lifted the share price 15 cents early.
